prompts.base: Edit the supplied approved Luna illustration to prepare the first Live2D material layer. Output at the exact same 1024x1536 canvas, identical pose, position, scale, silhouette and illustration style. Remove ONLY both eyes (including eyelashes, iris, whites, eyelid lines), both eyebrows, and the mouth line/highlight, seamlessly reconstructing the underlying peach facial skin and subtle shading. Preserve nose and cheek blush. Preserve every other feature of the original exactly: cream and taupe ragdoll ears and hair, cream cable knit turtleneck sweater, fully clothed age-appropriate body, hands, dark trousers. Remove the background to actual transparent alpha, preserving fine hair edges. This is a featureless face BASE LAYER for subsequent placement of separate eyes and mouth, NOT a new character design or finished illustration. No replacement eyes, no closed eyelid lines, no mouth, no eyebrows, no text, no added objects. Exact registration to the reference is crucial.
prompts.features_rejected_scale: Use this image as an exact extraction target for a Live2D face layer. Output the same 1024x1536 canvas. Retain ONLY the two complete eyes (sclera, blue irises, pupils, highlights, upper lashes and lower eyelid lines), both eyebrow strokes, and the small smiling mouth. Each feature MUST stay at its exact original pixel location, scale, angle and appearance. Everything else must become genuinely transparent alpha: remove background, hair, ears, clothing, hands, face skin and nose. Keep only minimal antialiased peach edges directly touching the eye and mouth outlines, no big skin patches. No repositioning, no enlargement, no contact sheet layout, no labels or lines, no additional features. This is an aligned transparent facial-features texture to overlay on the original with the eyes and mouth removed. Faithful extraction, not redesign.
